svg.aria-label: Animated council debate from a real run
svg.text: #council · real run, excerpts · full transcript in examples/council-demo

g.text: 11 000 €/month for 6 months, but she must pause her 3-year client A.
Take it, but negotiate the transition first.
+30 000 € gross in 6 months; payments work raises her rates.
Not as set up. A will be lost, not paused.
A year without A costs 33 600 €, more than the whole gain.
Take it if A and B commit to a return path.
Low technical risk; the 3-week start is the danger.
"Maybe" means I'll replace you by month 3.
Keep 4–6 h/week for me and I stay.
Round 2 — correction: I counted A twice.
Losing A after the contract costs 16 800 €, not 33 600 €.
Take it only with a paid bridge for A + a notice clause.
5 claims failed the evidence check and were dropped.
